exportDescription: Download all your projects, translations, glossaries, templates, and settings as a single JSON file. Your vault credentials and backups are not included.
deleteDescription: Permanently erase your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone. We'll email you a one-time code to confirm.
deleteTokenSent: We emailed a confirmation code. Enter it below along with your email address to permanently delete your account.
reportBugsPrefix: Found a bug? Report it to
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorInvalidConfirmation: The code or email didn't match. Please check both and try again.
mfaDescription: Protect your account with a time-based code from an authenticator app, required at sign-in. There is no account recovery without your authenticator, so keep your setup key safe.
mfaEnrollScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually, then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
mfaQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfaDisableHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to turn off two-factor authentication.
mfaErrorEnroll: Could not start enrollment. Please try again.
mfaErrorVerify: That code didn't match. Please try again.
mfaErrorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
devicesDescription: Vaults you've set up on other devices. Forgetting a device removes its saved vault key — you'll need to set it up again there to unlock the credential vault.
devicesEmpty: No other devices have set up the credential vault yet.
devicesError: Couldn't load your devices. Please try again.
deviceForgetError: Couldn't forget this device. Please try again.
notificationsDescription: Alerts about your account and platform activity.

cause.noRoute: no translation module is set up for it.
cause.moduleDisabled: the module it needs is turned off.
cause.moduleNotFound: the module it needs could not be found.
